items.question: Which subtype has the highest average ESR1?

attempts.sql: SELECT pam50_subtype, AVG(log2_expr) AS avg_esr1 FROM clinical JOIN rna_samples ON clinical.patient_id = rna_samples.patient_id AND rna_samples.sample_type_code = '01' JOIN gene_expression ON rna_samples.sample_id = gene_expression.sample_id WHERE gene_expression.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' GROUP BY pam50_subtype ORDER BY avg_esr1 DESC LIMIT 1;

items.final_sql: SELECT pam50_subtype, AVG(log2_expr) AS avg_esr1 FROM clinical JOIN rna_samples ON clinical.patient_id = rna_samples.patient_id AND rna_samples.sample_type_code = '01' JOIN gene_expression ON rna_samples.sample_id = gene_expression.sample_id WHERE gene_expression.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' GROUP BY pam50_subtype ORDER BY avg_esr1 DESC LIMIT 1;
items.reference_sql: SELECT c.pam50_subtype FROM gene_expression g JOIN rna_samples s ON s.sample_id = g.sample_id JOIN clinical c ON c.patient_id = g.patient_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' AND s.sample_type_code = '01' AND c.pam50_subtype IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.pam50_subtype ORDER BY AVG(g.log2_expr) DESC LIMIT 1
